stage: Research; frozen 36-episode pilot; no automatic holdout
hypothesis: The already tested persistent lifecycle provides safe completion beyond head_on_13 without new obstruction or realtime failure.
execution_order: scene, then seed, then B/C0/C1; one logical CPU sequentially
frozen: Original plant/CV observation/control/command delay/limits/checker/completion, original finite search proposal, beam64/horizon2s/cost, nine emergency actions and .05m physical threshold. C1 lifecycle unchanged from base.
metrics: Per-episode and pooled distributions, all failures and worst; proposal/commit/backup/actual command from external trace; no raw in Git.

go.completion: not lower than B or C0
go.initialization: 12/12 and valid reserve every executed cycle
go.benefit: stable safety or task benefit across multiple initial conditions beyond original fixture

modify: Positive signal with a clear bounded mechanism defect; no modification during this pilot.
stop: Only original fixture benefits, marked static/crossing/multiple regression, frequent unavailable/obstruction, realtime failure, or requires library/threshold/tuning expansion.

analysis_conventions.conservatism: Report every paired completed traversal/wait delta; repeated >10% slower traversal in >=2/3 of a non-head-on class is a warning, not a replacement for safety/completion gates.
analysis_conventions.timeout: No arrival by 40s. Deadlock requires evidence of persistent failure to progress; do not label every timeout or wait as proven deadlock.
analysis_conventions.sequence_churn: Inherited aligned absolute-time sequence target RMS.
analysis_conventions.action_switch: Count changes of actually executed target >1e-7; sum Euclidean changes as command total variation.
analysis_conventions.backup_execution: Count actual .01s steps carrying backup ownership, separately nonzero vs brake/rest; dispatch is not execution.
analysis_conventions.latency: Full measured total_cycle_ms per executed control slot including revalidation/IPC/transaction/queue preparation; excludes evaluator/log serialization. Initialization separately. Count full-cycle >50ms independently of inherited counters.
analysis_conventions.rss: Sum of consumers individual peak RSS, not simultaneous total process peak; Python evaluator excluded.

failure_review: Finish prespecified 36 for comparison; inspect first C1 gate failure and one unchanged confirmation outside primary 36. No tuning and no broader scenario expansion.
data: External generated raw JSONL/lifecycle/logs; source/config/small summaries/manifest/plot/report only in Git.
